fact: In June 2025 ST Digital's CEO states Cameroon has four Tier III standard datacentres (Orange, Camtel, MTN, ST Digital), Camtel's certified Tier III Design by Uptime Institute and ST Digital's by independent bodies such as OIX; Campost and Cenadi are nearer Tier II.
title: Datacenters certifiés, écosystème délaissé au Cameroun
